findings.claim: Bookkeeping paths and words leaked positives. hide.visible_files now drops every .okf/ and .loop/ path for every unit alike, and LEAK also drops sentences naming .okf/, summary.md, log.md, 'next free' and 'the number'. signals.py and judge.py both read only visible_files and strip output.

Spike 1 could not fail. Spike 2 checks with detectors that share nothing with strip: visible bookkeeping paths score AUC 0.50 and a separate record-keeping word list AUC 0.64, and the plan names that residue for the README.

Record-only positives now have a rule: a positive whose unit changes nothing outside .okf/ and .loop/ is reported apart, out of the recall count (only ADR 0030 in the range), and row r2 fails if one is counted in recall.

The judge runs on all 161 units, not a sample, and the bars are set before the run: recall >= 70% with Wilson lower end >= 50%, precision of claims on negatives >= 50%, range cost <= $10. Row r2 checks the README's verdict against them.
